{{Quote|Tojnun was an influence, obviously, but I made it my own.|Sabine Wren explains her artistic style to Alrich Wren|<ref name="Heroes of Mandalore" />}}
'''Tojnun''' was an [[artist]]. Associated with the [[Pre-Exile Masters]], Tojnun influenced the [[Mandalorian warrior]] [[Sabine Wren]] as she developed her own artistic style. During the [[Mission to Mandalore]]<ref name="Heroes of Mandalore" /> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Sabine helped to rescue her [[Parent|father]], [[Alrich Wren]], from [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] captivity. When the two reunited, Alrich noted that his [[Clan Wren|daughter's]] design aesthetic was emblematic of the Pre-Exile Masters, and while Sabine stated that her style was her own, she admitted that Tojnun had been an influence.<ref name="Heroes of Mandalore" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tojnun was mentioned in the first part of ''[[Heroes of Mandalore|Star Wars Rebels: Heroes of Mandalore]]'',<ref name="Heroes of Mandalore" /> the two-part premiere of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', which aired on [[October 16]], [[2017]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-rebels-season-four-viewing-schedule|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Four Viewing Schedule|date=2017-09-20}}</ref>
